poll.q: Aaj ki sab se bari khabar kaun si hai — khala se AI poem, Fa'az missile, ya petrol ki doosri kami?
options: 🛰️ Google ka khala se AI poem — future yahin hai
🚀 Fa'az missile test — apna hathiyar, apni taqat
⛽ Petrol phir sasta — seedha faida aam aadmi ko
🏏 Tri-series jeet + jurmana — jeet bhi, sabak bhi

https://www.businesstoday.in/technology/.what: Google ke Suncatcher satellite ne khala mein TPU par Gemma 4 chala kar pehla AI haiku zameen par bheja; sirf 1 kW power par ek chip 20 minute chalta hai.
https://www.businesstoday.in/technology/.why: AI ko chahiye bijli aur cooling — zameen par dono mehngi hoti ja rahi hain, is liye Google dekh raha hai ke kya compute khala mein sasta aur solar-powered ho sakta hai.
https://www.businesstoday.in/technology/.next: 2027 mein laser links wale do satellites batayenge ke ye sirf demo tha ya asal infrastructure ki shuruat.
https://www.businesstoday.in/technology/.take: Meri take: haiku sunne mein pyara lagta hai, lekin asal kahani bijli hai. Jo company AI ki power problem ko pehle hal karegi, wohi agle 10 saal jeetegi — chahe woh zameen par ho ya khala mein. Bas ek baat: khala mein data centre banana aasan nahi, 1,800 Starship flights wali estimate yaad rakhna.

https://www.reuters.com/business/openai-.what: Reuters ke mutabiq OpenAI ke employees saalon se keh rahe the ke internal security kamzor hai — code ek monorepo mein, info aasani se accessible; October mein recording device milne ke baad company ne engineers security par laga diye.
https://www.reuters.com/business/openai-.why: AI race mein speed sab kuch ban gayi hai — jab tezi hi strategy ho, to security pehle qurban hoti hai, aur ye sirf OpenAI ka masla nahi.
https://www.reuters.com/business/openai-.next: OpenAI ka 'next internal security sprint' aur Anthropic ke hack ke baad AI labs par security audit ka pressure barhega.
https://www.reuters.com/business/openai-.take: Meri take: ye report is liye zaroori hai ke ye kisi bahar ke hacker ki kahani nahi, andar ke logon ki warning hai jo ignore hui. Jab company ke apne log keh rahe hon ke darwaza khula hai, to us par action na lena laaparwahi nahi, choice hai — aur ab ye choice sab ke saamne hai.

https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/02/new-yo.what: NYT aur 3 aur akhbaron ne Brave par case kiya — 30 billion pages ka index, AI companies ko content bechna, aur paywall bypass ka ilzaam.
https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/02/new-yo.why: AI ki training aur answers ke liye content chahiye, aur content banane walon ko us ki qeemat chahiye — ye jang ab browser tak pahunch gayi hai, sirf chatbot tak nahi.
https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/02/new-yo.next: Court ka faisla batayega ke search index banana copyright violation hai ya fair use — poori AI industry is case ko dekh rahi hai.
https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/02/new-yo.take: Meri take: Brave ne apni pehchan privacy wale browser ki banayi thi, aur ab us par 'chor' ka label lag raha hai — ye irony hai. Sach ye hai ke AI ki poori economy kisi aur ke content par khari hai, aur ye case us hisab ki pehli qist hai, aakhri nahi.

https://www.techtimes.com/articles/32992.what: Meituan ka LongCat-2.5 — 1.6T parameters, 48B active per token, domestic Chinese chips par trained, company ke benchmarks ke mutabiq Claude Opus 4.8-5 ke darmiyan.
https://www.techtimes.com/articles/32992.why: US export controls ne China ko Nvidia chips se door rakha, to China ne architecture se jawab diya — MoE mein sirf chhota hissa chalta hai, is liye kamzor chip bhi kaam aa gayi.
https://www.techtimes.com/articles/32992.next: Independent benchmarks batayenge ke ye model waqai frontier ke qareeb hai ya sirf company ki marketing table hai.
https://www.techtimes.com/articles/32992.take: Meri take: khana deliver karne wali company ab frontier AI bana rahi hai — ye line apne aap mein batati hai ke AI ki race mein koi bhi peeche nahi rehna chahta. Lekin jab tak bahar ke testers ye model khud na chalayein, is ke numbers ko khushkhabri nahi, daawa samjho.

https://www.reuters.com/business/openai-.what: OpenAI ne ex-Army Secretary Dan Driscoll ko national security modernization ka senior counselor banaya; wo batayenge ke AI defence aur cybersecurity mein kaise use ho.
https://www.reuters.com/business/openai-.why: AI ab sirf product nahi, strategic asset hai — is liye AI companies seedha Pentagon aur governments ke saath baith rahi hain.
https://www.reuters.com/business/openai-.next: Dekhna ye hai ke ye role sirf advisory rahega ya OpenAI ke defence contracts ka darwaza kholega.
https://www.reuters.com/business/openai-.take: Meri take: jab ek AI company apne boardroom mein general bitha le, to samajh jao ke AI ki larai ab sirf market share ki nahi rahi. Ye theek bhi hai aur thoda darawna bhi — technology jitni taqatwar hoti hai, utni hi us ke faislay siyasat ke qareeb aa jate hain.

https://epaper.chinadaily.com.cn/a/20261.what: China ne 2026-30 plan mein 'AI Plus' ko gehra karne ka elaan kiya — AI har industry mein, pilot projects se nikal kar coordinated use tak.
https://epaper.chinadaily.com.cn/a/20261.why: China ke liye AI sirf tech sector nahi, poori economy ka engine hai — jab state khud plan banaye, to adoption speed alag hoti hai.
https://epaper.chinadaily.com.cn/a/20261.next: Agli reports batayengi ke ye plan manufacturing aur services mein kitni tezi se nazar aata hai.
https://epaper.chinadaily.com.cn/a/20261.take: Meri take: hum aksar AI ko chatbot samajhte hain, China is ko factory, farm aur hospital ka hissa bana raha hai. Ye farq yaad rakhna — jo mulk AI ko sirf app samjhega, wo peeche reh jayega; jo is ko infrastructure samjhega, wo aage nikal jayega.

https://www.brecorder.com/news/amp/40447.what: Petrol Rs 5.45 kami ke baad Rs 369.06 aur diesel Rs 3.68 kami ke baad Rs 391.52, aaj 4 November se — haftay mein doosri kami.
https://www.brecorder.com/news/amp/40447.why: Global crude 2% gir kar 3 haftay ki low par aaya, is liye hukumat ko relief dene ki gunjaish mili — aur petrol levy par JI se baat cheet bhi chal rahi hai.
https://www.brecorder.com/news/amp/40447.next: Agle fortnight ki review batayegi ke ye silsila jaari rehta hai ya crude wapas upar jata hai.
https://www.brecorder.com/news/amp/40447.take: Meri take: do din mein do kami achi lagti hai, lekin ye yaad rakhna ke ye relief crude ki qeemat se aaya hai, kisi permanent policy se nahi. Jab tak levy Rs 80 per litre hai, petrol ki asal qeemat ka aadha bojh wahi hai — kami ka shukrana ada karo, lekin is ko sasta petrol samajhna jaldi hogi.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2041885.what: Pakistan ne pehla apna air-to-air missile Fa'az ka kamyab test kiya — JF-17 se launch, advanced terminal guidance, lambi range.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041885.why: Apna missile banana sirf defence nahi, self-reliance ka signal hai — jo mulk apna hathiyar khud banata hai, wo kisi aur ki marzi ka mohtaj nahi rehta.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041885.next: Induction timeline aur asli range abhi disclose nahi hui — wo details batayengi ke ye test kitna operational hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041885.take: Meri take: ye khabar is liye khaas hai ke ye kisi imported system ki khareed nahi, apne engineers ki mehnat hai. Haan, range aur specs chhupana samajh aata hai, lekin awaam ko ye bhi batana chahiye ke is kaam ke peeche kitne saal ki research thi — taake naujawan engineers ko rasta nazar aaye, sirf headline nahi.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2041809.what: Mohmand mein polio duty par jaate 2 policemen shaheed, 1 zakhmi; Tank mein 4 polio workers aghwa — 24 million bachon ki campaign ke dauran.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041809.why: Polio workers par hamla sirf ek team par hamla nahi, poori campaign par hamla hai — ek din ki rukawat bhi hazaaron bachon ko risk mein daal deti hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041809.next: Tank ke workers ki recovery aur campaign ki security arrangements par sab ki nazar rahegi.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041809.take: Meri take: jo log bachon ko qatre pilane ja rahe hain, un par goli chalana na siyasat hai, na mazhab hai — ye seedha zulm hai. Polio ki larai mein sab se bara dushman virus nahi, ye khauf hai jo workers ko rokta hai. In shaheedon ka naam yaad rakhna chahiye, sirf number nahi.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2041745.what: Pakistan ne tri-series final jeeta (Fakhar 127, 326 chase) lekin slow over-rate par 5% match fee jurmana bhi laga; Shaheen ne ghalti maan li.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041745.why: Over-rate ka rule boring lagta hai, lekin ye game ki discipline hai — jeet ke saath bhi rule sab par barabar lagta hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041745.next: Quaid Trophy ke opening round mein Babar aur Shaheen ki form par nazar rahegi, Sri Lanka Tests se pehle.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041745.take: Meri take: trophy jeetna mubarak hai, lekin jurmana bhi ek yaad dilaata hai ke jeetna hi kaafi nahi, tareeqe se jeetna bhi zaroori hai. Fakhar ka 127 is final ki asal kahani hai — jab team early collapse ke baad bhi wapas aaye, to wohi champion wali nishani hai.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2041875.what: Balochistan ke Kachhi aur Kharan mein 2 IBOs mein 17 dehshatgard halak, Sanni mein roadblock ki koshish nakaam; Sepoy Hikmatullah shaheed.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041875.why: Balochistan mein dehshatgardi ka pattern roadblock aur hideout dono se chalta hai — is liye operations bhi dono jagah ek saath hue.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041875.next: Sanitisation operations ke baad pata chalega ke ye network kitna kamzor hua ya sirf ek hissa kata gaya.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041875.take: Meri take: 17 ka number headline ban jata hai, lekin ek shaheed ka naam us se zyada bhaari hai. Security operations ki kamyabi sirf halakaton se nahi naapi jaani chahiye — asal sawal ye hai ke jo log in ko bhej rahe hain, un tak kab pahuncha jayega.

https://www.brecorder.com/news/40447178/.what: KSE-100 Tuesday ko 1,454.80 points barh kar 168,018.86 par band — US-Iran talks ki umeed par crude sasta, investor sentiment behtar; rupee Rs 276.71.
https://www.brecorder.com/news/40447178/.why: Pakistan ki market ka mood ab sirf local numbers se nahi, global siyasat se banta hai — oil sasta ho to import bill, inflation aur market teeno ko rahat milti hai.
https://www.brecorder.com/news/40447178/.next: US midterms aur Iran talks ka natija batayega ke ye rally tikti hai ya sirf ek din ki khushi thi.
https://www.brecorder.com/news/40447178/.take: Meri take: 1,455 points ki tezi dekh kar fomo mein mat aao — analysts khud keh rahe hain ke ye recovery headline-driven hai, aur koi bhi kharab khabar is ko wapas le ja sakti hai. Market mein paisa wahi bachata hai jo khabar par nahi, company ke fundamentals par khareedta hai.

mood: 🛰️ Khala se AI poem, 🚀 Fa'az ka test, ⛽ petrol mein doosri rahat — aaj tech mein wonder, Pakistan mein garma-garmi.
